# The Market Journal

> Real estate insights from Steven Smith and Team Smith at The Market Real Estate Co. (Baton Rouge, LA; licensed in Louisiana and Alabama).

## Posts

- [What Can You Ask For After a Home Inspection? Repairs, Credits, or a Lower Price](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-to-ask-for-after-a-home-inspection/): After an inspection, buyers can usually ask for repairs, a credit at closing, or a price reduction. Here is how to choose and what to put in writing.
- [How Do You Become a Real Estate Agent in Louisiana or Alabama?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-to-become-a-real-estate-agent-louisiana-alabama/): Louisiana requires 90 hours of pre-licensing education and Alabama 60, plus an exam and a broker. Here are the steps and what comes after.
- [How Much Should You Budget for Home Maintenance Each Year?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-much-to-budget-for-home-maintenance/): A common rule is to set aside 1% to 2% of your home's value each year for upkeep. Here is how to size the number for your own home.
- [Should You Sell Your Home During the Holidays or Wait Until Spring?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/should-you-sell-your-home-during-the-holidays/): Winter is slower for sales, but buyers who shop in December are often serious. Here is how to decide whether to list now or wait.
- [How Much Are Closing Costs for Buyers, and Who Pays Them?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-much-are-closing-costs-for-buyers/): Buyers usually pay 2% to 5% of the purchase price in closing costs. Here is what is in that number and how to plan for it.
- [How Do Real Estate Agents Get Paid? What Buyers and Sellers Should Know](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-do-real-estate-agents-get-paid/): Agents earn a negotiated commission, usually paid at closing and only if the deal closes. Here is how it works for buyers and sellers after 2024.
- [What Happens If Your Home Appraisal Comes In Lower Than the Offer Price?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-happens-if-your-home-appraisal-comes-in-low/): A low appraisal doesn't have to end the deal. You can challenge errors, renegotiate, bring more cash, or walk away if your contract allows.
- [What Do October's Home Sales Numbers Mean for Buyers and Sellers?](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-october-home-sales-mean-for-buyers-and-sellers/): Existing-home sales fell 5.5% in October while prices held steady and supply grew. Here is what that means for buyers and sellers.
- [How to Choose a Real Estate Team (and What to Look For in Greater Baton Rouge)](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/how-to-choose-a-real-estate-team/): Verified production, real reviews, and a clear plan matter most. Here are the questions to ask, and how we answer them in Greater Baton Rouge.
- [What Should Homeowners Do Before the First Freeze? A Winter Checklist](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/winter-home-checklist-before-first-freeze/): Insulate exposed pipes, test your alarms, service your heating system, and seal air leaks. Here is a practical winter checklist for any home.
- [How AI Search Is Changing the Way People Find a Real Estate Agent](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/ai-search-and-your-next-agent/): More buyers and sellers are asking AI assistants who to call. Here's what that means for consumers and for agents.
- [The 5 Questions Every Seller Asks First](https://marketjournalrealestate.com/posts/what-sellers-ask-first/): What's my home worth, how long will it take, and what do I need to fix? Straight answers to the questions we hear most.
